clue.text: Capital avenue

explanation.definitionFit: Means can be wealth (a man of means) or a method (a means to an end).

clue.text: Very small computers with integrated circuit must include PC

standard abbreviation

clue.text: Gemstone found in a street up north

blocks.note: used as it stands

explanation.surface: A precious stone turns up on a street in the north of England.
explanation.walkthrough: "Up north" is not a direction here; it flags a northern dialect word. In York and other northern towns, gate is the old word for a street.

clue.text: Noteworthy painting, one you may find arresting

clue.text: Speaker from memory, perhaps one moving in speech

explanation.definitionFit: A reciter delivers poems or passages from memory.

standard abbreviation

clue.text: Admitted fish is eating starter of nothing ordinary

clue.text: Be brief, how does one make saga sag?

clue.text: Did rest like kids’ films? Soppy

blocks.note: to sit is to rest
U-rated films in Britain are suitable for all ages

explanation.definitionFit: Soppy literally means soaked through, saturated.
